mapper.insert: INSERT INTO xsy_trace_unit (unit_code, lot_id, package_type, quantity, unit, status, remark, created_by) VALUES (#{unitCode}, #{lotId}, #{packageType}, #{quantity}, #{unit}, 'ACTIVE', #{remark}, #{createdBy})

INSERT INTO xsy_trace_event (unit_id, lot_id, event_type, source_document_type, source_document_id, occurred_at, operator, remark, created_by) VALUES (#{unitId}, #{lotId}, 'ISSUE', NULL, NULL, #{occurredAt}, #{operator}, #{remark}, #{operator})
mapper.select: SELECT t.id AS lotId, t.lot_no AS lotNo, t.source_lot_no AS sourceLotNo, t.sku_id AS skuId, k.sku_code AS skuCode, k.spec_name AS skuName FROM xsy_trace_lot t LEFT JOIN xsy_product_sku k ON k.id = t.sku_id WHERE t.id = #{lotId}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(quantity), 0) FROM xsy_trace_unit WHERE lot_id = #{lotId}
SELECT unit FROM xsy_inventory_lot_balance WHERE lot_id = #{lotId} LIMIT 1
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(quantity), 0) FROM xsy_inventory_lot_balance WHERE lot_id = #{lotId}
SELECT id, quantity FROM xsy_inventory_lot_balance WHERE lot_id = #{lotId} ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE

SELECT r.warehouse_id FROM xsy_purchase_receipt_item_lot l JOIN xsy_purchase_receipt_item i ON i.id = l.purchase_receipt_item_id JOIN xsy_purchase_receipt r ON r.id = i.purchase_receipt_id WHERE l.lot_id = #{lotId} AND r.deleted = FALSE ORDER BY r.id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT u.id, u.unit_code AS unitCode, u.lot_id AS lotId, t.lot_no AS lotNo, t.source_lot_no AS sourceLotNo, u.package_type AS packageType, u.quantity, u.unit, u.status, u.remark, u.created_at AS createdAt, u.created_by AS createdBy FROM xsy_trace_unit u LEFT JOIN xsy_trace_lot t ON t.id = u.lot_id WHERE 1 = 1 AND u.lot_id = #{query.lotId}
AND u.unit_code ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.unitCode}, '%')
AND t.lot_no ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.lotNo}, '%')
AND u.status = #{query.status}
AND FALSE
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM xsy_purchase_receipt_item_lot rl JOIN xsy_purchase_receipt_item ri ON ri.id = rl.purchase_receipt_item_id JOIN xsy_purchase_receipt r ON r.id = ri.purchase_receipt_id WHERE rl.lot_id = u.lot_id AND r.deleted = FALSE AND r.warehouse_id IN #{scopeId} )
ORDER BY u.id DESC

SELECT u.id, u.unit_code AS unitCode, u.lot_id AS lotId, t.lot_no AS lotNo, t.source_lot_no AS sourceLotNo, u.package_type AS packageType, u.quantity, u.unit, u.status, u.remark, u.created_at AS createdAt, u.created_by AS createdBy FROM xsy_trace_unit u LEFT JOIN xsy_trace_lot t ON t.id = u.lot_id WHERE u.unit_code = #{unitCode}

SELECT u.id, u.unit_code AS unitCode, u.lot_id AS lotId, t.lot_no AS lotNo, t.source_lot_no AS sourceLotNo, u.package_type AS packageType, u.quantity, u.unit, u.status, u.remark, u.created_at AS createdAt, u.created_by AS createdBy FROM xsy_trace_unit u LEFT JOIN xsy_trace_lot t ON t.id = u.lot_id WHERE u.unit_code = #{unitCode} FOR UPDATE OF u

SELECT u.id, u.unit_code AS unitCode, u.lot_id AS lotId, t.lot_no AS lotNo, t.source_lot_no AS sourceLotNo, u.package_type AS packageType, u.quantity, u.unit, u.status, u.remark, u.created_at AS createdAt, u.created_by AS createdBy FROM xsy_trace_unit u LEFT JOIN xsy_trace_lot t ON t.id = u.lot_id WHERE u.id = #{id}

SELECT r.receipt_no AS receiptNo, r.supplier_name_snapshot AS supplierName, r.confirmed_at AS confirmedAt FROM xsy_purchase_receipt_item_lot l JOIN xsy_purchase_receipt_item i ON i.id = l.purchase_receipt_item_id JOIN xsy_purchase_receipt r ON r.id = i.purchase_receipt_id WHERE l.lot_id = #{lotId} AND r.deleted = FALSE ORDER BY r.confirmed_at DESC NULLS LAST, r.id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT i.task_id AS taskId, i.id AS itemId, i.sku_id AS skuId, i.sales_order_id AS salesOrderId, i.sales_order_item_id AS salesOrderItemId, i.customer_id AS customerId, i.customer_name_snapshot AS customerName, i.order_no_snapshot AS orderNo, i.sorted_quantity AS sortedQuantity, t.status AS taskStatus, t.warehouse_id AS warehouseId FROM xsy_sorting_task_item i JOIN xsy_sorting_task t ON t.id = i.task_id WHERE i.id = #{itemId} AND i.deleted = FALSE FOR UPDATE OF i

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(u.quantity), 0) FROM xsy_trace_unit_binding b JOIN xsy_trace_unit u ON u.id = b.unit_id WHERE b.sorting_task_item_id = #{itemId} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM xsy_trace_unit_unbind ub WHERE ub.binding_id = b.id)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO xsy_trace_unit_binding (unit_id, lot_id, sorting_task_id, sorting_task_item_id, sales_order_id, sales_order_item_id, customer_id, customer_name_snapshot, order_no_snapshot, bound_at, bound_by, created_by) VALUES (#{unitId}, #{lotId}, #{taskId}, #{itemId}, #{salesOrderId}, #{salesOrderItemId}, #{customerId}, #{customerName}, #{orderNo}, #{boundAt}, #{operator}, #{operator})

INSERT INTO xsy_trace_event (unit_id, lot_id, event_type, source_document_type, source_document_id, occurred_at, operator, created_by) VALUES (#{unitId}, #{lotId}, 'BIND', 'SORTING_TASK_ITEM', #{itemId}, #{occurredAt}, #{operator}, #{operator})
mapper.update: UPDATE xsy_trace_unit SET status = 'VOID' WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO xsy_trace_event (unit_id, lot_id, event_type, occurred_at, operator, remark, created_by) VALUES (#{unitId}, #{lotId}, 'VOID', #{occurredAt}, #{operator}, #{reason}, #{operator})
mapper.select: SELECT b.id FROM xsy_trace_unit_binding b WHERE b.unit_id = #{unitId} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM xsy_trace_unit_unbind u WHERE u.binding_id = b.id) ORDER BY b.id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT b.sorting_task_id AS sortingTaskId, b.sorting_task_item_id AS sortingTaskItemId, b.order_no_snapshot AS orderNo, b.customer_name_snapshot AS customerName, b.bound_at AS boundAt, b.bound_by AS boundBy FROM xsy_trace_unit_binding b WHERE b.unit_id = #{unitId} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM xsy_trace_unit_unbind u WHERE u.binding_id = b.id)

SELECT o.outbound_no AS outboundNo, m.occurred_at AS occurredAt, SUM(-m.quantity) AS quantity FROM xsy_inventory_lot_movement m JOIN xsy_inventory_outbound o ON o.id = m.source_document_id WHERE m.lot_id = #{lotId} AND m.movement_type = 'SALES_OUT' GROUP BY o.outbound_no, m.occurred_at ORDER BY m.occurred_at DESC LIMIT 20
